verses.text: Haton wab'ixal a in Nehemías in tik, yuninal in winhaj Hacalías. Ayik 20 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal, t'a jun uj skuchan Quisleu, ayinek' t'a Susa skapitalil Persia.
Hata' ix k'och winh wuk'tak skuchan Hanani yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix kot yet' winh t'a Judá. Ix in k'anb'an t'a heb' tas yaj Jerusalén yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' anima ik'b'ilkot t'a Babilonia.
Ix yalan heb' t'ayin: Ha heb' ketchonhab' chi' ayek' heb' t'a Judá, te kusk'olal yajek' heb', te q'uixweltak yajek' heb'. Haxo Jerusalén chi' mak'b'ilem smuroal, tz'anakpaxb'at spuertail, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix wab'an juntzanh chi', ix in em k'ojan, ix in oq'ui. Ix in te kus wal jaye' k'ual. Ix in och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix in lesalwi t'a sDiosal satcha'anh.
Ix walan icha tik: Mamin Jehová sDiosal satcha'anh, te niwan elk'ochi, te ay a may, tzak'elk'och a trato yet' heb' tzach xajanani, heb' sk'anab'ajan a cheknab'il.

Tzin k'an t'ayach to tza cha ab' in lesal a in a chekab' in tik. T'a junjun k'u yet' t'a junjun ak'wal tzin tewi t'ayach kuuj a onh a chonhab' onh tik, a chekab' kaji. Swalk'eta ko mul t'ayach. Ha onh tik yet' heb' ko mam kicham, ix och ko mul t'ayach.
Te chuk ix kutej ko b'a t'ayach. Maj ko k'anab'ajej a cheknab'il, a k'ayb'ub'al yet' tas a chek yalnakkan winh a chekab' aj Moisés t'ayonh.
Nakot tas alnak t'a winh a chekab' chi': Tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej tas ix wala', ol ex in saklemejkanb'at t'a skaltak juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il.

Palta tato ol ex meltzajxok t'ayin jun, ol he k'anab'ajan in cheknab'il, tze b'eyb'alani, wach'chom sakleminak eyajkanb'at b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol ex in molb'ejxikot t'a jun lugar to sik'b'ilel wuuj, b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, xa chi.
Ha onh a chekab' onh tik, a chonhab' onh paxi, ix onh a kol yet' a poder.

Mamin, tzin k'an t'ayach to tza cha ab' in lesal a in a chekab' in tik yet' tas sk'an juntzanhxo heb' a chekab' to sko nib'ej tzach kik'chaanh. Tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yik wach' scha yab' winh rey tas ol wala', xin chi. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ayin och sb'akhumalok swino winhaj rey Artajerjes chi'.
